_note: CURATED HERO CASSETTE (E7). These requirements + part candidates are AUTHORED, not live-derived: a deterministic, offline stand-in for the reasoning model so the hero demo intent 'USB-C powered I²C temperature sensor, < 1 W' produces on-topic requirements that flow clean through all 15 phases to a released ManufacturingIr, and replay byte-identically. Loaded by eak-cli/tests/hero_flow.rs via RunConfig.cassette. A single `default` response serves both the requirement_candidates_v1 and part_candidates_v1 schemas (the requirement agent reads `candidates`, the part agent reads `part_candidates`), exactly like default_cassette.json. Geometry is deliberately catalog-clean: the wording classifies into Connector + Ic only (NO Regulator, whose catalog part is EOL and would block release), no Fabrication/frequency/thermal/current targets are stated (so those DRC/DFM/EMC/thermal rules stay silent), and the 50 mm board comfortably fits the 4 courtyards. The part candidates name only catalog-carried MPNs, so every proposal is ACCEPTED at the catalog seam (the moat: model proposes, kernel validates).

candidates.statement: Device shall draw operating power from a USB-C receptacle
candidates.acceptance_criterion: A USB-C receptacle is present and the device draws bus power when connected
candidates.rationale: The intent names USB-C as the power-entry interface.

candidates.statement: Digital temperature sensor shall report die temperature over the I²C bus
candidates.acceptance_criterion: The sensor returns a valid temperature reading over I²C at the addressed device
candidates.rationale: The intent's core function is an I²C-addressable temperature sensor.

candidates.statement: Total board input power shall not exceed 1 W
candidates.acceptance_criterion: Measured total input power under nominal load is < 1 W
candidates.rationale: The intent states a 1 W power ceiling for the whole board.

candidates.statement: Board outline shall fit within a 50 x 50 mm area
candidates.acceptance_criterion: Maximum board extent <= 50 mm on each axis
candidates.rationale: A compact USB-C sensor peripheral fits a small square outline.

part_candidates.rationale: USB-C receptacle realizing the USB-C power-entry connector class.
Low-power host controller for the I²C temperature-sensor load class (catalog part for the Ic class).
